text:
maria.chen: kicking off the Sherpa v2 canary toggle now — want to pin to 7% in eu-west-1 and 3% globally. will follow with rollout schedule.
ajay.patel: ack. flag name?
maria.chen: flag = `sherpa_v2_canary` with params `regions=[eu-west-1]`, `percent=7`, `global_percent=3`. also enabling `kv-prefix-cache` for this test.
jamie: @ajay.patel quick Q: do we have auto-fallback to sherpa-v1 if error rate > 1.5%? last time we needed manual revert.
ajay.patel: yes — rollout policy set to fallback->sherpa_v1. check `rollout_policies/sherpa_v2.json`. automation will flip `sherpa_v2_canary=false` and route traffic back.
eli_sre: leaving a note — oncall alert thresholds: p95 latency > 600ms OR error_rate > 1.5% for 5m => page. also we have a 'gradual-decr' sampler to avoid traffic spikes.
maria.chen: thanks. I'll post the dashboard link once it's live. plan: 7% eu for 30m, then +10% every 45m if metrics good, while global remains at 3% until eu stabilizes.
jamie: can we add a quick smoke user pin list so we can exercise long-tail prompts? `sherpa_v2_pin_users = ["team-internal", "se-specific"]`
ajay.patel: done. added pins. also turned on structured logs for canary: header `x-rollout-id` will be injected for tracing.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary start accepted for `sherpa_v2_canary` by maria.chen at 1939456789 — tasks queued.
maria.chen: tiny ask — can someone run a dry-run of the flag toggle in staging with the region override `eu-west-1`? want to validate kernel selection differences on E4 vs H100 shapes.
eli_sre: i'll run the staging dry-run now and paste results. if anything shows >10% token time variance we pause.
jamie: also add a quick alert to the console for quality regressions comparing rouge/embedding drift on a tiny eval set. set threshold to 2%.
ajay.patel: added eval-check with webhook -> slack channel #eng-runtime-alerts. if drift >2% it will annotate the rollout in the dashboard.
maria.chen: perfect. i'll start the production toggle at the scheduled time and ping here once it's live. thanks all. :rocket:
eli_sre: staging run finished: kernel picks differ slightly, median token time +6% on E4 but p95 unchanged. no errors. recommending proceed with watch.
maria.chen: proceeding to enable `sherpa_v2_canary` at 7% eu-west-1 now. tagging rollout id `roll-1939456789-sherpa`.
deploy-bot: canary: `sherpa_v2_canary` enabled (regions: eu-west-1=7%, global=3%). rollout_id=roll-1939456789-sherpa
jamie: oncall: watching the dashboards. if anything noisy i'll trigger the rollback script.
eli_sre: added a short runbook comment: `if error >1.5% AND requests/sec drops 20% => run rollback.sh roll-1939456789-sherpa` and notify SRE and eng-ml.
ajay.patel: all good. one follow-up: schedule a canary audit in 24h to collect user-feedback samples and edge-case prompts.
maria.chen: noted. thanks everyone — will post update after the first 90m window.
